description: Dispositivos Conectados en las Zonas Wifi del Distrito de Cartagena. is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía Mayor de Cartagena de Indias, Bolívar. Este conjunto de datos está basado en el número de dispositivos que se conectan en las zonas wifi del Distrito de Cartagena. Coverage: Alcaldía Mayor de Cartagena de Indias, Bolívar. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía Mayor de Cartagena de Indias, Bolívar. Its tags are sistema, edad. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution | NoDerivatives 4.0 International License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
